Announcement24 August 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
1.3.6 Preview - Taming
Fifth post in our series of features on Discovery (1.3.6). Today's post presents Taming.

In the months since the comet passed, herders and hunters have been telling the same story. Beasts that once kept to the deep brush have started coming into the open. Boars on the green pastures of Solzreed. Grubs along the cold ridgelines of the Karkasse high country. Ants and stranger things dragging themselves out of heat-cracked desert washes after dusk.

Nobody agrees on why. Some say that the land is restless while others say that the beasts can feel a fight coming and are choosing sides. What is certain is that adventurers have begun following them, looking for a companion that will stand alongside in battle against the dark forces.

Taming

Taming is the first custom profession that is being added to ArcheAge Classic, as part of 1.3.6 - Discovery. This profession will fall under the "Special" category, and revolve all around taming wild beasts out in the world, either using these as your own personal mounts, or exchanging them for materials used in various ways throughout the folio of crafting recipes.

▶ Watch the video

Taming the Creature

Tameable beasts appear as wild stragglers around Erenor. They are marked Tameable Beast. You'll find wild tameable beasts all around regions that have a climate typical for their species to live in, such as Ants in Windscour Savannah, and Jabberwocks in Hellswamp. Alongside wild, wandering tameable beasts, you can instigate one to come out of their slumber by slaughtering its own kind in one of these regions.

▶ Watch the video

The Tamer's Equipment

Tamer's Equipment Backpack

Name Effect
Greenhorn's Backpack Greenhorn's Backpack
Taming Proficiency: None.
------
A rucksack of all the tools an aspiring tamer would need to wrestle in their first beast.
Wrangler's Backpack Wrangler's Backpack
Taming Proficiency: 80,000.
------
For someone experienced with taming beasts. Now that they aren't a greenhorn, their toolkit has been tailored for efficiency.
Herdmaster's Backpack Herdmaster's Backpack
Taming Proficiency: 200,000.
------
Merely for decoration, a Herdmaster could wrangle a beast into submission without any of these tools. However, there's a sense of status that comes from the way this pack sits on their back.

The Tamer's backpack grants unique skills that match the beast's mood. When the beast is Scared, Soothe it to gain its trust. Should you Dance when the beast is angry or scared, they will lose trust and eventually flee. Using the wrong action at the wrong time may cause the beast to grow wary of you, making it more difficult to gain its trust. As you gain access to the more advanced sets of tools available in the higher quality of backpacks, you'll notice taming beasts becomes marginally easier.

Your New Companion

A tame is made up of a grade, personality, and species. Grade determines the mount's base movement speed, personality decides its 3rd, 4th, and 5th skills, and species decides its 1st and 2nd.

The first two skills will stay the same across personalities, but remain unique to each mount species. The remaining three slots are randomized between either the default skill available to the species at that level, or the skill added by its personality at that level.

In total, there are four personalities: Hasty, Ferocious, Resolute, and Spunky.

As an example, here are the possibilities for a Hasty-personality Boar. Reminder, all grades have the same skill pool.

Skill # Species (Boar) Personality (Hasty)
Skill 1 Run! —
Skill 2 Protective Instincts —
Skill 3 Penetrating Horn Leader of the Pack
Skill 4 Detect Smell Guardian's Eyes
Skill 5 Blazing Skin Elegant Leap

▶ Watch the video

Returning It to the Wild

Stablehands now sell a Wildcaller Flute. Using one on a mount returns it to the wild and yields Whistles of the Wild.

Whistles of the Wild

Whistles of the Wild are used to craft taming equipment, mount armor, and various other crafts.

Mount Armor

Mount armor is worn in three pieces: the shaffron, the saddle, and the cannonguards. Each piece is made in three tiers, beginning with the base nameless tier, then Regal, and then Ornate. There are four variants: Swift for a mount whose arts should return more quickly, Stout for one that should stand against harm, Survey for the pack so the beast can still walk while carrying, and Support for the company around it, restoring their mana. The steel is the same from one variant to the next. What changes is the path, and with it the set.

Taming Armor Shaffron

Name Effect
Shaffron +325 Armor
+325 Magic Resistance
+20 Continuous Health Regen
+20 Continuous Mana Regen
Regal Shaffron +500 Armor
+500 Magic Resistance
+28 Continuous Health Regen
+28 Continuous Mana Regen
Ornate Shaffron +600 Armor
+600 Magic Resistance
+32 Continuous Health Regen
+32 Continuous Mana Regen

Saddle

Name Effect
Saddle +1250 Health
+800 Mana
+2.5% Move Speed
Regal Saddle +1500 Health
+1000 Mana
+3.5% Move Speed
Ornate Saddle +1750 Health
+1200 Mana
+4.5% Move Speed

Cannonguards

Name Effect
Cannonguards +7.0% Move Speed
+7.0% Evasion
Regal Cannonguards +10.0% Move Speed
+9.0% Evasion
Ornate Cannonguards +11.5% Move Speed
+11.0% Evasion

Set Effects

Three matching pieces of the same path and tier activate set effects, increasing in potency with each tier.

Set Effects Swift

Name Effect
Swift Mount skill cooldown -10%.
Regal Swift Mount skill cooldown -14%.
Ornate Swift Mount skill cooldown -16%.

Stout

Name Effect
Stout Incoming damage -6%.
Regal Stout Incoming damage -6.8%.
Ornate Stout Incoming damage -7.4%.

Survey

Name Effect
Survey +16.0 move speed while carrying a pack.
Regal Survey +20.0 move speed while carrying a pack.
Ornate Survey +22.0 move speed while carrying a pack.

Support

Name Effect
Support Ally mana regeneration aura.
Regal Support Ally mana regeneration aura.
Ornate Support Ally mana regeneration aura.

Set Effect Example - Survey

With a 3 piece set of Survey, any mount you'd like can become a viable donkey replacement. Though, they won't have the same carrot-based diet.

▶ Watch the video

Potential

Taming armor can be regraded like other gear, granting gem slots with higher grade. A full Ornate set filled with Celerity gems will be the fastest mount in Erenor. Mix this with each species of beast being a little different than any other currently available mount, Taming quickly becomes the best way to find the perfect companion for yourself. Such as a cute Crab that is most comfortable in the water. Maybe that does the trick for you.

▶ Watch the video

Taming Consumables

Whistles of the Wind are not only used for taming equipment and mount armor, but in various other consumables that will become available to players. These consumables have recipes that mingle with existing economies and material ecosystems, while offering exclusive effects that you can't find anywhere else, such as:

  • Snacks giving your mounts a boost in speed for a short amount of time
  • Food that can be fed to your mount, to restore its Health and Mana over a short period
  • Emergency potions that can give your companion a burst of Mana
  • Meals that increase your Combat Pet's capabilities
  • Actually viable mount resurrection options while on the go

These are just the beginning, and as time goes on, Taming will only become more intertwined with existing systems.

Additional costs and exact recipes will not be revealed at this time.
